description: RFC 0008 stage 4 mutation battery (post-review): L3 builder kinds/chance/payload/live-count, all three resource caps, deepest-cover; L2 cover and declared-schedule reduction; L4 button/preflop projection/runout validation and conditioning/mode/identity refusals. Every mutation must turn its suite red. 19 caught / 0 equivalent.

expected.rationale: Each mutation changes a node kind, chance set, terminal payout/live count, a resource bound, the deepest cover, schedule reduction, a projected field, or a runout/mode/identity guard that an independent oracle, the projection unit test, or a bit-for-bit/typed-refusal conformance observes. None is behavior-preserving on the bounded fixtures.

mutations.name: tree classifies a folded terminal as a showdown
tree classifies a showdown terminal as a fold
tree drops the highest public card from every chance set
tree marks an action node as a chance node
fold payload records an empty utility instead of the settled vector
showdown ledger reports the wrong live count
node cap is silently ignored so an oversized build succeeds
mutations.find:
if (nodes == limits_.max_nodes)
      throw tree_resource_exhausted("abstract tree exceeded the node cap");
mutations.replace:
if (false && nodes == limits_.max_nodes)
      throw tree_resource_exhausted("abstract tree exceeded the node cap");

mutations.name: byte cap is silently ignored so an oversized build retains the slab
mutations.find:
if (bytes_ > limits_.max_bytes)
      throw tree_resource_exhausted("abstract tree exceeded the byte cap");
mutations.replace:
if (false && bytes_ > limits_.max_bytes)
      throw tree_resource_exhausted("abstract tree exceeded the byte cap");

mutations.name: depth cap is silently ignored so an over-deep build succeeds
mutations.find:
if (path_depth > limits_.max_depth)
      throw tree_resource_exhausted("abstract tree exceeded the depth cap");
mutations.replace:
if (false && path_depth > limits_.max_depth)
      throw tree_resource_exhausted("abstract tree exceeded the depth cap");

mutations.name: tree multiway cover takes only the first other seat, not the deepest
L2 menu ignores cover entirely and caps at the legal maximum
mutations.find: const Chips cap = std::max(bounds.minimum, std::min(bounds.maximum, cover_total));

mutations.name: schedule constructor skips reduction, leaving an unreduced fraction stored
solve projects the wrong button, changing actor order and the golden policy
preflop projection swaps the posted blinds between seats
preflop projection emits a non-sentinel flop card
solve drops request runout conditioning (always free runout)
solve stops rejecting a fixed card that is already on the board
solve always runs full traversal, ignoring the sampled-mode golden stream
mutations.find:
TrainingResult result = request.mode == SolveMode::ExternalSampling
                              ? trainer.train_sampled(request.iterations, request.seed,
                                                      request.limits.training_limits())
                              : trainer.train(request.iterations, request.limits.training_limits());

mutations.name: solve accepts a non-identity action abstraction instead of refusing it
mutations.find:
if (tree.action_id() != abstraction::identity_action_id())
    throw unsupported_tree_shape("heads-up CFR solves only the identity action abstraction");
mutations.replace:
if (false && tree.action_id() != abstraction::identity_action_id())
    throw unsupported_tree_shape("heads-up CFR solves only the identity action abstraction");

mutations.name: solve treats a present negative fixed card as absent (leaks invalid_argument)
